key_reasoning.reason: A single new UNION ALL branch added to one repository method (`get_session_detail_dispatches` in `PostgresCliAnalyticsReader`), self-contained in one component; it reuses existing CTEs (`t`, `launched`, `dispatch_fork`, `stopped`, `agent_usage`) rather than introducing new ones.

The new branch is modeled tightly on the existing 'skill fallback' branch immediately above it in the same UNION (same join shape against `stopped`/`agent_usage`), with explicit NOT EXISTS guards against `t`/`launched` and `dispatch_fork` to prevent double-counting (CR-001). The accompanying live-Postgres test file exercises exactly the enumerated edge cases (fleet overlap, OTel+hooks duplicate, slash-command foreground fork duplicate), so the defensive pattern is covered rather than left as an open risk.
